text:
jordan: Heads-up — I'm planning to enable pii_retention_ttl_override for embeddings to 90d in a canary region (us-west-2). Need ops + security ack before I flip. We'll route KMS to hsm-primary with kms-rotation-fallback to software-kms if HSM hits errors. Anyone object?

nina: Can you paste the exact flag/config you intend to push?

jordan: Sure:
```yaml
feature_flag: pii_retention_ttl_override
scope: canary:region=us-west-2,percent=5
value: 90d
kms_policy:
  primary: hsm-primary
  fallback: software-kms
audit_mode: verbose
scrub_level: prefix-only
```

maria: Quick Q — is 90d compliant for EEA customers? I think policy requires 60d for EU.

jordan: Good catch. This canary is US-only. I'll add region-scoped override for EU=60d and exclude EU from this rollout.

liam: ops check — please confirm autoscaling won't evict KV cache during canary when retention window is shortened. Last time cache churn spiked and added latency.

deploy-bot: deploy queued by jordan for branch feature/retention-ttl-canary. CI green. Estimated deploy in ~15m.

nina: Security question — verbose audit_mode will increase log volume substantially. Any estimate?

security-bot: FYI — verbose audit will likely ~2x log volume for the affected paths. Recommend snapshot-mode instead of always-verbose unless we need full trace for debug.

maria: Security/legal approvals conditional on: (1) canary limited to 5% us-west, (2) EU explicitly excluded, (3) KMS rotation deferred until after successful canary, (4) audit_mode=snapshot only.

jordan: Agree. Updating plan: set audit_mode=snapshot, canary=5% us-west, EU excluded. KMS rotation deferred post-canary. Reposting config.

jordan: ```yaml
feature_flag: pii_retention_ttl_override
scope: canary:region=us-west-2,percent=5
value: 90d
kms_policy:
  primary: hsm-primary
  fallback: software-kms
audit_mode: snapshot
notes: EU excluded from this rollout
```

liam: Ops green on cache risk with that limited scope. We'll keep an eye on token-store churn and have a rollback playbook ready.

nina: I'll add a short runbook and an alert rule: pii_retention_ttl_override.delta > 15% -> page oncall.

deploy-bot: deploy started by jordan. Host: rdx-canary-usw2-01

jordan: Live. Dashboards: https://grafana.redwood/platform/retention-canary (watch retention.delta and kms.errors)

maria: Checked audit snapshots — being created as expected. No KMS errors reported so far.

security-bot: thumbs up. We'll schedule a key-rotation window after the canary validates for 48h.

jordan: Thanks all. Rolling notes into the RFC. I'll open a follow-up thread for post-canary KMS rotation and rotation playbook.

nina: Ping me when you want the runbook linked in Console docs.

liam: Adding rollback commands to the ops runbook now (commands + quick revert flag).

maria: Ack from legal for the canary scope.

jordan: Closing thread for now — will report back after 48h with metrics and final decision.
